notes.title: Ver1.05 Patch Notes for "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Quest of Memories
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Quest of Memories".

A new patch for "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Quest of Memories" (available from June 20, 2024) has been released as of July 25, 2024, 1:00 UTC.

The updates included in this patch are as below.
■What’s new
・Fixed an issue where the enhancement effect is not reflected after enhancing an equipped accessory
・Fixed an issue where the screen turns dark and freezes after accepting the quest “Forest Cartography”.
・Changed the ESC key function for the Steam version so that pressing it does not close the game.
・Adjustment to the required material quantity for the skill “Second Wind”
・ “Serpent King Scale” will be available for purchase in Millishion after certain requirements are met.
・Miscellaneous bug fixes

■Version
"Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Quest of Memories"
PlayStation 4（Ver.1.05）/ PlayStation 5（Ver.1.05）
Nintendo Switch™（Ver.1.05）/ Steam（Ver.1.05）

We apologize for any inconveniences caused, and we hope you continue to enjoy playing "Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Quest of Memories".
